title: yian.events.v1
description: One yian observer event as {name, data}: name is the event's class name and data its JSON form. Keys are snake_case. Every key a data form lists is always present (null where it allows null). This schema describes this version exactly; later versions only add event names, keys and enum values, which a consumer ignores when it doesn't know them: a consumer checking against an older copy skips an event whose name it doesn't know, and treats an unknown key or enum value as unknown, not invalid; an unknown failure code is still a failure. Values the flow produced appear in yian's JSON codec form (see $defs/value). In-loop events (ModelCallStarted, ModelCallFinished, ToolCallStarted, ToolCallFinished, ReplayDegraded), ModelCallRetried and stream chunks are transient: they are never recorded or replayed. In-loop events arrive while a node runs; ModelCallRetried, and a ReplayDegraded published during AGENT backward or with node_id __memory__, come from outside a forward node. $defs/StreamChunk is also the data of a stream chunk forwarded on its own.

value.description: A value the flow produced, in yian's JSON codec form: ints and floats as JSON numbers, and a value handed to a host doesn't keep the int/float kind, so 2 may be a float; infinity as {"$float": "inf"} and minus infinity as {"$float": "-inf"}; a record with that shape, or whose only key is $record, wrapped as {"$record": <record>}; a file as {uri, mime, name}.

failure.description: A failure: its stable code, message, failing node and authored origins.

code.description: The failure's stable category, documented in docs/api.md "Failure codes".

message.description: Human-readable detail; it may be empty.

node_id.description: The node that failed, or null when no single executing node did.

trace.description: The authored origins of the failure, outermost first; the last is the most precise.

cause_type.description: The thrown error's type name, for debugging only.

traceback.description: The thrown error's stack, opaque debugging text.

token_usage.description: Provider-reported token counts for one model call; an optional detail is null when unreported.

grow.description: A spawner's seed-first growth: the expansion the runtime records.

seed.description: The input to the growth builder, persisted so replay rebuilds the same topology.

prune.description: Ids to retire in the same step, sorted by UTF-16 code units.

StreamChunk.description: A streamed fragment of a node's output, such as model text. A completed or interrupted AGENT stream ends with one empty final chunk; a failed call ends without one (its ModelCallFinished.error is set), and a host discards that attempt's partial text.

key.description: What the stream carries: "text" for AGENT reply text.

final.description: True on the empty chunk that ends a completed or interrupted stream.

n.description: The n of the AGENT model_call step the text belongs to (node_id + n is the step id; a retried attempt streams under the next n); null for other streams.

index.description: The chunk's number within its step, dense from 0, the final chunk included; null for other streams.

NodeSucceeded.description: A node finished and produced its single output value.

commit_as.description: The target the value was committed under instead of node_id; null when it was committed under node_id.

interrupted.description: TS yian, which always sends it (Python yian doesn't): true only for an AGENT that honored a host interrupt and succeeded with null because its output is Optional(...); false when an interrupt landed after the reply was whole. Read from the recorded interrupted step, so a resumed run says the same.

NodeRouted.description: A router (CASE) selected an out-edge; its siblings are skipped.

handle.description: The taken branch: a case's then: target id, or "#else" for its else: route, also taken when no when: matches.

NodeSkipped.description: A route made a node unreachable.

NodeExpanded.description: A spawner returned a growth; its fragment's terminal commits the node's eventual value.

crashed.description: How many of the node's attempts crashed (started, with no outcome and no stop covering them), derived from the log; a deliberate stop doesn't count, so a node restarted only after stops has 0.

NodeWaiting.description: A node stopped running to wait on calls; it holds no worker.

call_ids.description: The calls the node waits on.

NodeWoken.description: A waiting node went back in flight to run again.

timed_out.description: The node's calls that timed out, possibly none.

CallClosed.description: A host call was closed without an answer; a later answer to it is refused.

ModelCallStarted.description: An AGENT node is about to call its model (in-loop, transient).

n.description: The n of the model_call step the attempt becomes; node_id + n is the step id.

purpose.description: Why the node calls its model.

started_at.description: When the attempt started: a UTC RFC 3339 time with milliseconds.

ModelCallFinished.description: One model call returned or raised (in-loop, transient).

n.description: The n of the attempt's model_call step, as on its ModelCallStarted.

purpose.description: Why the node called its model.

usage.description: The provider's own token count, or null when it reported none; a cut stream reports the usage received so far.

error.description: The error's type name when the call raised, never provider text; null when it returned or an interrupt cut its stream.

ToolCallStarted.description: An AGENT node is about to run one granted tool call from a model reply (in-loop, transient).

n.description: The n of the model_call step whose reply asked for the call.

call_index.description: The call's 0-based position in the reply.

tool_call_id.description: The provider's id for the call.

ToolCallFinished.description: One tool call returned or raised (in-loop, transient).

n.description: The n of the model_call step whose reply asked for the call.

call_index.description: The call's 0-based position in the reply.

tool_call_id.description: The provider's id for the call.

result.description: The tool's result text; null when it raised or was skipped.

error.description: The error's type name when the tool raised, or "interrupted" for a call an interrupt skipped (the tool did not run); null when it returned.

ReplayDegraded.description: An AGENT's model left out replay state it couldn't send back, once per reason per invocation; the replayed turns' text and tool calls were still sent (in-loop, transient). One published during AGENT backward (under the AGENT's node_id) or with node_id __memory__ (a memory's learner) comes from outside a forward node; in practice it can't fire there, since those requests replay no assistant message. A backward pass also publishes one with reason rebuilt_request_differs, under an AGENT's node_id, when a request rebuilt from that occurrence's recorded steps doesn't match the digest its step recorded (or its render, recall, structured model or tool groups can't be rebuilt); learning then reads no prompt, memory sections or interactions of that occurrence, while its backward call and memory episodes still run with its inputs, output and feedback.

reason.description: Why the replay state was left out; rebuilt_request_differs: why learning read no prompt, memory sections or interactions of an occurrence.

ModelCallRetried.description: TS-only (Python yian publishes nothing): a model call outside a forward node (AGENT backward, a memory's learner) failed with a retryable error and is sent again after retry_in seconds; published before the wait (transient).

node_id.description: The AGENT's id during backward, or "__memory__" for a memory's learner.

consumer.description: Who made the call: "backward" for AGENT backward, or "memory:<key>" for the learner of the memory under <key>.

error.description: The provider error, scrubbed of credentials.

kind.description: What went wrong, independent of the provider.

RunStarted.description: The lead event of a fresh run.

RunResumed.description: A recovered run segment began after its unfinished nodes were requeued.

RunFailed.description: The run ended on a node failure or an unreachable terminal output.

RunWaiting.description: The run holds no worker: every unsettled node waits for a delivery or a deadline. Not a terminal.

node_ids.description: The waiting node ids, in the order they began waiting.

RunCancelled.description: The run ended because its host cancelled it.
